claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows Yamaha brand name and model PSR-175 on the control panel.
No photo shows power-on, key response, sound, or screen operation.
The report shows the keyboard but no wear, age, or usage indicators.
Photo 0 shows model PSR-175 visible on the right side of the panel.

risks.proof: Video of the keyboard turning on with a power adapter or batteries.

risks.risk: Some or all keys do not work.
risks.proof: Video of every key being pressed and producing sound.
Audio clip of sound playing through the speakers.
Video showing the screen lit and readable.

risks.risk: Buttons and knobs do not work.
risks.proof: Video demonstrating panel buttons and knobs.
Photo of the power adapter with the keyboard.
Photo of the music rest attached or packed with the item.
Photo of the serial number sticker or original receipt.

risks.risk: Physical damage not visible in this angle.
risks.proof: Additional photos of all sides, back, underside, and key bed.
Service records or close-up photos of seams and screws indicating the case was opened.

proof_requests: Video of the keyboard powering on and playing notes.
Photos of the back, sides, and underside for damage.
Photo of the serial number sticker for age.
response.reason: The witness identifies the item as a Yamaha PSR-175 keyboard, so it can be priced at its worst case; functionality and accessories are unproven and priced as non-working or incomplete until verified.
